about: Ajax is a lakeshore town in Durham Region, east of Toronto between Pickering and Whitby. It was named for HMS Ajax and grew from a wartime munitions site into a suburban commuter municipality. A long Lake Ontario waterfront trail is the town’s main public landscape. About 130,000 people live in Ajax.
seoSummary: Durham lakeshore town named for HMS Ajax, between Pickering and Whitby.
knownFor: GO Transit and Highway 401 commuter town
